name: hubitat-dashboard
description: Minimal-setup Hubitat dashboard: select your devices and you're done. Room-grouped layout with clean names, installable PWA, fully hosted on your hub.
author: Ephrayim (evdev)

scripts.test: node --test test/app-config.test.mjs test/app-devices.test.mjs test/app-favorites.test.mjs test/app-preferences.test.mjs test/app-thermostats-api.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/app.js test/app-config.test.mjs test/app-devices.test.mjs test/app-favorites.test.mjs test/app-preferences.test.mjs test/app-thermostats-api.test.mjs
